item_short_desc: Stay cool and blend in with bold style. Rothco’s Woodland Camo Beach Towel is made from 100% soft and absorbent cotton, delivering comfort whether you're hitting the beach, lounging poolside, or drying off after a tough workout. Measuring 30" x 60", this towel offers full coverage and quick-drying performance. Its iconic Woodland Camo pattern brings a rugged edge to your summer essentials – perfect for military enthusiasts and outdoor adventurers alike.
